title: Prior in, prior out: R code of the re-analysis of 56 cyclostratigraphic estimates of Earth's precession constant
description: R scripts, run settings and prepared series of the re-analysis of 56 published cyclostratigraphic estimates of Earth's precession constant k (Arts, Paleoceanography and Paleoclimatology, submitted). The saved runs are archived in a separate record.
